garment.label: Garment
garment.definition: One physical piece of clothing, footwear or accessory in the wardrobe, owned at some point since tracking began.

category.label: Category
category.definition: A kind of clothing that groups garments. The 13 categories, in their standard order: Jackets and hoodies, Blazers and vests, Knits, Shirts, T-shirts and tanks, Pants, Shorts, Belts, Socks, Shoes, Underwear shirts, Underwear boxers, Sportswear.

tracking-start.label: Start of tracking
tracking-start.definition: 1 January 2018, the first day of the daily log.

wear.label: Wear
wear.definition: One garment worn on one day, as logged. Wearing a garment more than once on the same day is still one wear.

pre-tracking-wears.label: Pre-tracking wears
pre-tracking-wears.definition: The number of times a garment was worn before tracking began, entered once as an estimate.

price.label: Price
price.definition: What was paid for the garment, in euros, rounded to whole cents.

ownership-period.label: Ownership period
ownership-period.definition: The days a garment counts as owned: from its purchase date, but no earlier than the start of tracking, to its divest date, both inclusive.

active.label: Active
active.definition: A garment is active on a day if that day is within its ownership period.

divested.label: Divested
divested.definition: No longer owned after the divest date, because it was sold, given away, recycled or discarded.

date-range.label: Date range
date-range.definition: The period a figure is computed for, from a start date to an end date, both inclusive. Every metric takes a date range; the default is from the start of tracking to the last logged day.

as-of.label: As of
as-of.definition: A figure computed as it was known on a past date, counting only wears logged up to then. Used by the animated charts.

times-worn.label: Times worn
times-worn.definition: The number of wears of a garment within the date range, plus its pre-tracking wears when the range starts on the start of tracking.

lifetime-wears.label: Lifetime wears
lifetime-wears.definition: All wears of a garment over its whole ownership period, including pre-tracking wears.

cost-per-wear.label: Cost per wear
cost-per-wear.definition: For a garment: its price divided by its lifetime wears, regardless of the date range chosen. A garment never worn costs its full price. For a category: the sum of the prices of its garments owned in the range divided by the sum of their lifetime wears, so unworn garments count with their full price (divided by 1 if none has ever been worn).

use-weighted-average.label: Use-weighted average
use-weighted-average.definition: An average in which each garment counts as many times as it was worn in the range.

wears-per-month.label: Wears per month
wears-per-month.definition: Times worn divided by the months owned in the range, where a month is 30.5 days.

days-used.label: Days used
days-used.definition: For a category: the share of days on which at least one of its garments was worn, counted from the later of the range start and the day the category's first garment was owned, to the range end.

yearly-cost.label: Yearly cost
yearly-cost.definition: What a year of using a category costs at the current rate - its cost per wear × 365 × days used.

monthly-cost.label: Monthly cost
monthly-cost.definition: Yearly cost divided by 12. Used to compare clothing categories with other monthly spending.

inventory-value.label: Inventory value
inventory-value.definition: The sum of the prices of the garments active on the range's end date.

active-items.label: Active items
active-items.definition: The number of garments active on the range's end date.

turnover.label: Inventory turnover
turnover.definition: Yearly cost divided by inventory value - the share of the wardrobe's purchase value "used up" per year.

second-hand-share.label: Second hand share
second-hand-share.definition: The share of the garments active on the range's end date that were bought second hand (a count, not a value share).

daily-cost.label: Daily cost
daily-cost.definition: For a day, the sum of the cost per wear of the garments worn that day (and owned then).

final-daily-cost.label: Final (daily cost)
final-daily-cost.definition: A day's cost is final when every garment worn that day has been divested, so it can no longer fall.

tag.label: Tag
tag.definition: A descriptive label from a fixed vocabulary. Tags only describe garments; they never change any calculation.

second-hand.label: Second hand (tag)
second-hand.definition: Bought second hand, i.e. used before. The price is what was paid and wears count from the purchase, without estimating earlier use.

hanko.label: Hanko (tag)
hanko.definition: Kept at the summer home in Hanko, so worn only during stays there.

season-tags.label: Winter / Summer (tags)
season-tags.definition: Worn mainly in winter or in summer; used to narrow the logging list by season.

materials.label: Materials
materials.definition: The garment's materials label as written, in free text (e.g. "Shell 100% polyamide, lining 100% polyester").

main-part.label: Main part
main-part.definition: For a garment whose label lists several parts (shell, lining, padding…), the part that counts in material figures: the one whose label begins with shell, main, outer, body, fabric or belt, otherwise the first one listed.

fibre.label: Fibre
fibre.definition: A material a garment is made of, under one normalised name (e.g. lycra and spandex are both elastane, nylon is polyamide).

fibre-class.label: Fibre class
fibre-class.definition: Natural (cotton, wool, linen, leather, down, feather), regenerated cellulose (viscose, modal, lyocell), synthetic (polyester, polyamide, elastane, acrylic…) or other.

estimated-composition.label: Estimated composition
estimated-composition.definition: A composition whose shares are not given on the label (or don't add up to 100 %), so the fibres are split equally or normalised.

fibre-mass.label: Fibre mass
fibre-mass.definition: Weight × composition, summed per fibre. Owned basis: garments active on the range's end date. Worn basis: every wear in the range counts the garment's full weight.

outfit-weight.label: Average outfit weight
outfit-weight.definition: The average total weight of the garments worn per logged day (garments with a known weight).

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.definition: How much of the data a material figure could use - garments or wears with both a weight and readable materials, out of all.

comparison-item.label: Comparison item
comparison-item.definition: An item of other everyday spending, such as a transport ticket or a streaming service, with a monthly cost and a use frequency.

use-frequency.label: Use frequency
use-frequency.definition: For a comparison item, the share of days on which it is used (entered by the owner).

cost-per-use.label: Cost per use (comparison)
cost-per-use.definition: For a comparison item, its monthly cost divided by (30.5 × use frequency).

times-worn.label: Times worn
times-worn.definition: Wears of the garment within the range (and within its ownership period), plus pre-tracking wears when the range starts on the start of tracking.
times-worn.formula: |{wear days d : range.from ≤ d ≤ range.to, d in ownership}| + (range.from ≤ 2018-01-01 ? timesUsedInit : 0)

lifetime-wears.label: Lifetime wears
lifetime-wears.definition: All wears over the garment's whole ownership period, including pre-tracking wears.

garment-cost-per-wear.label: Cost per wear (garment)
garment-cost-per-wear.definition: Price divided by lifetime wears, independent of any chosen range; a garment never worn costs its full price.

days-owned.label: Days owned
days-owned.definition: Days owned within the range up to its end, frozen at the divest date. When the range starts on the start of tracking, counted from the purchase date even before tracking (since pre-tracking wears are included too).
days-owned.formula: max(0, days(start .. min(range.to, divested))) with start = range.from ≤ 2018-01-01 ? purchased : max(range.from, ownedFrom)

wears-per-month.label: Wears per month
wears-per-month.definition: Times worn divided by months owned in the range (30.5 days per month); 0 if not owned in the range.

active-items.label: Active items
active-items.definition: Number of the category's garments active on the range's end date. Total row - the sum over categories.

inventory-value.label: Inventory value
inventory-value.definition: Sum of the prices of the category's garments active on the range's end date (unknown prices count as 0). Total row - the sum.
inventory-value.formula: Σ price over active garments on range.to

category-cost-per-wear.label: Cost per wear (category)
category-cost-per-wear.definition: The sum of the prices of the category's garments owned at any point in the range, divided by the sum of their lifetime wears. Unworn garments count with their full price and no wears; if none of them has ever been worn, the sum of prices is divided by 1 (as an unworn garment costs its full price). Garments without a price are left out. No Total row value.
category-cost-per-wear.formula: Σ price / max(1, Σ lifetime-wears), over the category's garments owned during the range with a price

days-used.label: Days used
days-used.definition: Share of days with at least one wear of a category garment, from the later of the range start and the day the category's first garment was owned, to the range end. No Total row value.
days-used.formula: |{days d in span : some category garment worn on d}| / |span|, span = max(range.from, min ownedFrom) .. range.to

yearly-cost.label: Yearly cost
yearly-cost.definition: Category cost per wear × 365 × days used. Total row - the sum over categories.

monthly-cost.label: Monthly cost
monthly-cost.definition: Yearly cost divided by 12, as in the original R comparison chart.

turnover.label: Inventory turnover
turnover.definition: Yearly cost divided by inventory value. Total row - Σ yearly cost / Σ inventory value.

second-hand-share.label: Second hand share
second-hand-share.definition: Share of the category's garments active on the range's end date that carry the second-hand tag (by count). Total row - over all active garments.

divested-averages.label: Divested items' averages
divested-averages.definition: Over divested garments owned at least 30 days: wears per month (Σ times worn / Σ days owned × 30.5) and the use-weighted cost per wear. Reference lines on category pages.
divested-averages.formula: (Σ times-worn / Σ days-owned) × 30.5; Σ (cost per wear × times-worn) / Σ times-worn

active-items-over-time.label: Active items over time
active-items-over-time.definition: Active items per category on every day of the range, as step series (Sportswear left out on the Dashboard).
active-items-over-time.formula: active-items(category, d) for each day d in range

inventory-value-over-time.label: Inventory value over time
inventory-value-over-time.definition: Inventory value per category (and in total) on every day of the range, as step series.
inventory-value-over-time.formula: inventory-value(category, d) for each day d in range

daily-cost.label: Daily cost
daily-cost.definition: For each logged day in the range with wears: the sum of the lifetime cost per wear of the garments worn and owned that day (unknown prices count 0); "final" when all of them are divested. Average - the mean of 30 consecutive logged days centred on the day (days i−14 … i+15), so days without wears are skipped.
daily-cost.formula: Σ garment-cost-per-wear over garments worn on d; average(i) = mean(cost[i−14 .. i+15])

fibre-mass.label: Fibre mass
fibre-mass.definition: Weight × main-part composition, summed per fibre, with recycled and organic kg. Owned basis - garments active on the range's end date. Worn basis - each wear in the range counts the garment's full weight. Only garments with a weight and readable materials are included; coverage says how many.

average-outfit-weight.label: Average outfit weight
average-outfit-weight.definition: Mean total weight of the garments worn per logged day (garments with a known weight).
average-outfit-weight.formula: Σ weight of garments worn / number of logged days

synthetic-share.label: Synthetic share (worn)
synthetic-share.definition: Share of the worn fibre mass in a month that is synthetic.

comparison-cost-per-use.label: Cost per use (comparison item)
comparison-cost-per-use.definition: Monthly cost divided by (30.5 × use frequency); none if never used.
